coordinate_frame: Main CAD metres; +Y retained; FBX forward -Y/up Z; UE reflects Y on import

road_audit.parking_island_policy: Clipped to parking parcels and 0.25m clear of the road union before grass, pavement holes and tree centres are generated.
road_audit.boundary_policy: Photographic reconstruction anchored to aligned CAD roads; not survey accuracy.

railway_audit.source_policy: CADMapper paths retained; endpoints/junction nodes exact; bounded local curve rounding.
railway_audit.freight_policy: 36 estimated dark tank cars in three source-aligned consists nearest Prologis Way; visual reference reconstruction, not surveyed occupancy.

alignment.heightPolicy: Assembly flattens campus to z=-1.2m, with main CAD finished floor z=0. CADMapper elevation retained only as source data; 1.2m dock difference inferred from reference, not surveyed.

assumptions: Context heights are inferred: adjacent warehouse 14m, other industrial 9m, homes 6m, sheds 3.2m.
Loading court and parking markings are screenshot-derived approximations; main CAD wall placement remains exact.
Exterior ground -1.2m relative to warehouse finished floor is a visual dock-level estimate, not a survey.
No exact tree/car location survey exists; compact landscape bands follow supplied images and exclude all pavement, buildings and railway corridors.

optimization.partition: Near campus and Far cardinal sectors; ground 280m tiles; road junction union removes coplanar overlaps

attribution: Map geometry from user-supplied CADMapper export / OpenStreetMap contributors; reference screenshots are not used as textures.
